chart.title: Countries that are democracies and autocracies
chart.subtitle: Classification by Lührmann et al. (2018) based on expert estimates by V-Dem.
chart.note: The share of closed autocracies increases a lot in 1900 because V-Dem covers many more countries since then, often colonies.

Number of closed autocracies (ambiguous).descriptionProcessing: We only count the countries that V-Dem covers in the given year. Where we impute a country's data from a historical entity it was part of, those imputed values are excluded from the count, because the country did not yet exist separately at the time.
